# Ableten

> Ableten is the social second brain for group planning—capture the highlights, links, screenshots, and recommendations your group shares, auto-organize them into shared collections, and turn them into itineraries and grounded drafts (not AI guesses).

### Terminology

- **Social second brain** — The category Ableten owns: a group's shared memory. Everyone's links, recs, screenshots, and notes land in one organized library, so the group can remember, discuss, and decide together. (Traditional second brain = solo: "I save so I can remember later." Social second brain = shared: "we save so we can decide together.")
- **Highlights** — Text (or OCR text) saved from a webpage, email, or screenshot, usually with an optional personal note.
- **Collections** — Shared topic folders that group related highlights; Ableten can suggest a collection when you save.
- **The library** — The web app (`app.ableten.xyz`) where the group's highlights, collections, and original notes live.
- **Original notes** — Your own ideas captured in the library (not tied to a web URL).
- **Chrome extension** — Highlight while browsing: select text, copy to open the note widget, save with a note.

Common use cases and workflows

- [A shared brain that files itself (collections)](https://ableten.xyz/#organize)

- [Plan from saved recommendations (Composer)](https://ableten.xyz/#plan)
